notes.title: Easy Bubbles – Twitch Chat Integration Is Here!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, aquarists,[/p][p]Easy Bubbles just got more interactive with your streams.
With the new [b]Twitch Chat Integration[/b], your viewers can influence your aquarium live.[/p][list][*][p][b]!bubbles[/b] — viewers drop food for your fish during the stream[/p][/*][*][p]Add a fun, community-driven layer to your broadcasts[/p][/*][*][p]Quick and simple setup[/p][/*][/list][p]Easy Bubbles isn’t just a game anymore—it’s a shared experience with your community.
Try it on your next stream and let your viewers feed the fish![/p]

notes.title: 27 New Country Flags for Your Aquarium
notes.content:
[p][b]Event Description[/b]
Show your colors. This update adds [b]27 country flag[/b] decorations to Easy Bubbles. Place them in your tank and share your screenshots in the Community Hub.[/p][p][b]Included flags[/b]
Turkey, United States, France, Italy, Germany, Spain, Egypt, Czechia, Denmark, Netherlands, Finland, Greece, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Norway, Poland, Brazil, Portugal, Romania, Russia, China (PRC), Mexico, Sweden, Thailand, Taiwan, Vietnam.[/p][p][b]How to place[/b]
Open the [b]Decorations[/b] menu → choose [b]Flags[/b] → position the flag and confirm.
Tip: Mix with different backdrops to create your favorite layout.[/p]

notes.title: Easy Bubbles v1.6 – Mythological Sea Creatures Pack
notes.content:
[p]Easy Bubbles v1.6 is now live!
This update introduces the [b]9th Fish Pack[/b]:
[b]Mythological Sea Creatures Pack[/b].[/p][list][*][p]The pack adds [b]58 new legendary sea creatures[/b] inspired by ancient myths.[/p][/*][*][p]These creatures are organized in a unique diagonal order, adding a mystical touch to your collection.[/p][/*][*][p]With this update, Easy Bubbles now features a total of [b]4,176 hand-drawn designs[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]This makes Easy Bubbles the game with the [b]largest creature list on Steam[/b]![/p][p]Dive in, explore the depths of mythology, and expand your aquarium with legendary beings of the sea.[/p]

notes.title: New Leaderboard — Total Species Discovered
notes.content: [h1][b]Easy Bubbles v1.5 — New Leaderboard: Total Species Discovered[/b][/h1][p]You’ve been climbing the [b]Total Aquarium Value[/b] ranks—now there’s a second way to compete. v1.5 adds [b]Total Species Discovered[/b], a global leaderboard that tracks how many unique fish you’ve found. Both leaderboards are visible together in the same [b]Leaderboards[/b] panel.[/p]

notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Easy Bubbles[/b] will be part of the upcoming [b]Games Against Living Miserably[/b] sale on Steam![/p][p] [b]What does this mean?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Easy Bubbles will be available at a special discount during the event.[/p][/*][*][p]The sale supports [b]World Suicide Prevention Day (Sept 10th)[/b], raising awareness for an important cause.[/p][/*][*][p]It’s the perfect chance to dive in, relax, and share the adventure with friends.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Event Dates:[/b]
September 8 – 15, 2025[/p][p]Thank you for being part of our community—together we can make this event meaningful while enjoying a cozy underwater journey.[/p]

notes.title: Easy Bubbles v1.4 – 58 Prehistoric Fish Added!
notes.content: [p][b]Easy Bubbles v1.4 – 8th Fish Pack Update[/b][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that the 8th Fish Pack is here, bringing [b]58 brand-new prehistoric fish[/b] to your aquariums! From mighty ocean giants to bizarre ancient swimmers, this update adds even more variety and depth to your underwater world.[/p][p][b]What’s new in v1.4:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🐟 [b]58 new prehistoric fish species[/b] to discover and collect[/p][/*][*][p]📦 The [b]8th Fish Pack[/b] expands your aquarium possibilities[/p][/*][*][p]🌊 More variety for your aquarium setups and combinations[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 Each fish is carefully designed with a unique look and charm[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re a collector aiming to complete your aquarium or just love relaxing with new aquatic friends, this update is packed with ancient wonders for you to enjoy.[/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting [i]Easy Bubbles[/i]! Your feedback and love help us keep growing the aquarium world.[/p]

notes.title: Easy Bubbles – Patch 1.3 is Live!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]✨ New & Improved[/p][list][*][p][b]Fish Transfer Between Tanks[/b]
Seamlessly move your aquatic friends from one tank to another without selling or rebuying them. Perfect for re‑balancing populations or showing off rare specimens.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Venomous Predators Fully Implemented[/b]
These dangerous newcomers have unique behaviors and will prey on smaller fish if left unchecked. Stock antivenom decorations—or risk losing your prized specimens.[/p][/*][/list][p]🛠 Fixes & Tweaks[/p][list][*][p][b]“Buy Max” Button Overflow Fixed[/b]
No more accidental overspending when your wallet is swimming in cash. The button now caps purchases correctly, even with astronomical funds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor Performance Optimizations[/b]
Faster tank‑switching and smoother UI animations on lower‑end PCs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization Pass[/b]
Updated strings in Turkish, German, and Simplified Chinese.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for all the feedback in our Discord and Steam forums—your suggestions shape every update. If you run into issues, let us know on the [b]Community Hub[/b].[/p][p]Keep bubbling!
—The Easy Bubbles Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Easy Bubbles — Full Release Is Live!
notes.content:
[p]The full version of [b]Easy Bubbles[/b] is now available on Steam. If you played the demo, you can pick up right where you left off—your progress transfers seamlessly into the complete game.[/p][p]As of today, no further updates will be made to the demo. I’m immensely grateful to everyone who tried the early build, reported bugs, and sent feedback. Your support shaped the final release.[/p][p]The full game offers a much larger, richer underwater experience with new species, advanced tank systems, and extended progression. If you’d like to sample the game first, a limited-content demo remains free on the store page, but all new features are exclusive to the full release.[/p][p]See you beneath the waves in the full version. Take care, and thanks again for being part of the journey.[/p][p]— Ahmet Babagil
Creator of [i]Easy Bubbles[/i][/p]
